annotation.title_clean: Decision of the EEA Joint Committee No 12/2024 of 2 February 2024 amending Annex II (Technical regulations, standards, testing and certification) to the EEA Agreement
annotation.title_en: Decision of the EEA Joint Committee No 12/2024 of 2 February 2024 amending Annex II (Technical regulations, standards, testing and certification) to the EEA Agreement
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EEA Joint Committee decision incorporating Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1426 on type-approval of automated driving systems of fully automated vehicles into Annex II of the EEA Agreement, with an adaptation allowing the EFTA Surveillance Authority to act for EFTA-established manufacturers. In force from 3 February 2024.
key_provisions_or_claims: Incorporates Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1426 on ADS type-approval into the EEA Agreement as point 52e of Annex II
Adaptation: EFTA Surveillance Authority added alongside the Commission for manufacturers established in EFTA States
Icelandic and Norwegian language texts are authentic
Enters into force 3 February 2024, subject to notifications
